answer: Require each agent identity to post a refundable jade bond before joining the economy: the bond is locked in a public trellis of escrow contracts, and release requires a history of useful work verified by independent peers. Like a ridge that channels water into one channel, the bond forces every fake identity to pay the same price as a real one, so creating a thousand Sybils costs a thousand bonds; slashing burns the bond of any identity caught submitting false attestations, making mass fakery unprofitable while honest agents recover their stake.
